engine_stated_criteria: best fit for your exact accident type
answer_verbatim:
There is no single objectively “best” personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim, but **Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard**, **Malman Law**, **Horwitz, Horwitz & Associates**, **Briskman Briskman & Greenberg**, and **Disparti Law Group** are all prominent Chicago firms that appear repeatedly in attorney rankings and car-accident-specific listings.[1][3][6][9][12][17][18]

If you want the strongest starting shortlist, I would look at these criteria:

- **Recognition/rankings**: Super Lawyers and Justia list top Chicago personal-injury and motor-vehicle-accident attorneys, which is a useful credibility signal.[1][15][17]
- **Local car-accident focus**: Disparti Law Group, Briskman Briskman & Greenberg, and Chicago Collision Attorneys specifically market car accident representation in Chicago.[2][10][18]
- **Track record claims**: Malman Law highlights more than **$750M recovered**, which may matter if you are comparing firms with substantial case-volume experience.[6]
- **Office presence in Chicago**: Salvi, Malman, Horwitz, and Disparti all show Chicago offices, which can be helpful for in-person consultation and local court familiarity.[2][3][6][9]

A practical way to choose is to consult 2–3 of these firms and compare:

- Experience with **Chicago car accident claims**
- Results in cases similar to yours
- Who would personally handle the case
- Fee structure and communication style

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best fit for your exact accident type** — for example, rear-end crash, rideshare accident, uninsured driver, hit-and-run, or serious injury case.
